subject: Urgent: FinSecure SIG evidence request — IRP walkthrough & incident packet
messages:
From: Emily Novak <enovak@finsecure.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@finsecure.com
Date: 2027-04-18 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + IRP timeline for last week's outage

Hi Diego,

Following vendor risk review of last week's availability event, we need to collect Redwood's SIG/CAIQ responses scoped to the incident window and a short walkthrough of your Incident Response Plan (IRP). Specifically FinSecure needs: 

- A copy of the IRP you would follow for a production outage that affects customer request latency/availability (redacted where necessary).
- A SIG/CAIQ mapping or SOC 2 control crosswalk showing where evidence exists for incident detection, response, and notification controls.
- A brief incident timeline (UTC) with impacted services, detection method, remediation steps, and artifact names/locations for forensic review.

Can you confirm if you can provide these artifacts by EOD 2027-04-20? We may need a short walkthrough (30 min) for our vendor risk reviewers — earliest availability tomorrow (2027-04-19) morning PT would be ideal.

Given this is a timeboxed request for a live procurement/security review, please let us know any required NDAs or access constraints.

Thanks,
Emily Novak
Head of Vendor Risk | FinSecure, Inc.
em: enovak@finsecure.com

Emily —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can meet the request and will provide an IRP walkthrough. Proposed plan: 

1) Share a redacted Incident Response Plan (IRP v2.1) and SOC2/SIG mapping spreadsheet by EOD 2027-04-18 for your reviewers to ingest.
2) 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow 2027-04-19 at 10:00 PT / 17:00 UTC — please confirm; we'll send a calendar invite.
3) After the walkthrough we'll deliver a short post-incident packet with timeline, artifacts, and a small forensics excerpt by EOD 2027-04-20.

Quick clarifications: we retain access logs and application traces for 90 days in S3 (immutable snapshots for 30 days), and we can provide sanitized excerpts for review. Full forensic bundles require an executed DPA addendum for deep access; let us know if you need that.

I have attached the initial artifacts for your review (redwood_irp_v2.1.pdf, soc2_sig_mapping_202704.xlsx). Marissa will lead the forensics handoff and Laura will cover control mappings during the walkthrough.

- Diego

Emily —

Appreciate the time this week. Attached is the post-incident packet agreed in the walkthrough and the artifacts we referenced:

Summary (high level):
- Incident window: 2027-04-14T03:20:00Z — 2027-04-14T03:55:00Z
- Root cause: transient routing misconfiguration affecting a subset of inference nodes (internal change rolled back within 12 minutes).
- Detection: automated alert (latency threshold) -> on-call page -> mitigation by infra team.
- Impact: increased latency for ~2% of production requests for ~35 minutes. No customer data exfiltration detected.

Attachments delivered: redwood_irp_v2.1.pdf; soc2_sig_mapping_202704.xlsx; forensics_logs_excerpt_20270418.tar.gz; postmortem_summary_20270420.md
Artifact access: 
- Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AFAKE-Redwood-FinSecure-evidence
- S3 presigned sample (7 day): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/fake-presigned-url (sample objects inside TAR)

Notes on evidence and controls:
- SOC2 mapping highlights: CC6 (incident response) — detection and mitigation runbooks exist, CC7 (communication) — notification timelines documented. SIG entries annotated in the spreadsheet for each control reference.
- Forensics: provided sample logs, hashes, and extraction README. Full forensic export available under DPA addendum and timeboxed access.

Please confirm receipt and whether the packet satisfies FinSecure's reviewer checklist, or if you need additional artifacts. We can sign an access addendum if deeper logs are required.
